rubric.marquee_window_rule: diff counts double for any game OUTSIDE Sunday 1:00pm-7:00pm ET kickoff (includes Sat games, Sun 9:30am international, MNF/TNF/SNF) - per RULES.md, the code's window test is authoritative, not the rubric prose
rubric.denominator_note: 32*150 banked + 272*10 game wins + 3900 playoff bonuses; pt diff is zero-sum. ERA-SPECIFIC: recompute if games/season or playoff field changes.

stage_targets.comment: League-wide inventory each stage's probabilities must sum to. Exact by NFL structure.

kalshi.series_note: Win totals ladder = 'N or more wins' contracts per team. Confirm elimination + spread series tickers each season via GET /series?category=... or /events search; tickers change (e.g. KXSB-27 vs KXSB-26).
kalshi.event_pattern_note: Event ticker = SERIES-{seasonCode}{TEAM}, e.g. KXNFLSTAGEOFELIM-27BUF (27 = 2026 season, matching KXSB-27). Team code is the event ticker suffix. Season code increments each year - update on rollover.
